name: Workspace Icons
author: Adrian Wild
description: Workspace number indicators that also show an icon for each app open on the workspace, including the program running inside terminals.

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers with the icons of the apps on each workspace.

schema.label: Colored icons
schema.description: Off shows the icons in greyscale.

schema.label: Show numbers
schema.description: Off hides the number on workspaces that have icons.

schema.label: Icon position
schema.description: Icons before the number, split around it, or after it.

schema.label: Show programs in terminals
schema.description: Show the icon of the program running in a terminal (e.g. nvim, btop) instead of the terminal icon.

schema.label: Icons per workspace
schema.description: One icon per distinct app, in window order.
